title: Fix reservation/booking bugs: blocked user removal, post-action UI refresh, and faster ticket acceptance

requirements.text: When an admin blocks a user, automatically cancel and remove all existing reservations and bookings made by that blocked user across all screenings. The backend must enforce this so that blocked users have no active reservations after being blocked.

quotes: fix the problem of not removing booking of people I have block

acceptanceCriteria: When a user is blocked by an admin, all their pending and confirmed reservations are cancelled in the backend data store.
Blocked users' seats are freed up and marked available again on the seat plan.
If a user is already blocked and attempts to make a new reservation, the backend rejects the request with an appropriate error.

requirements.text: After an admin accepts or denies a ticket/reservation in the ReservationManager UI, immediately refresh the reservation list and seat plan data without requiring a manual page reload. Invalidate and refetch all relevant React Query caches (reservations, seat plan) upon mutation success or failure.

quotes: fix the changes after the acceptance or denial of the ticket I have made
UI/state does not update correctly after ticket acceptance or denial

acceptanceCriteria: After confirming a reservation, the reservation list in ReservationManager updates instantly to reflect the new status without a page reload.
After cancelling/denying a reservation, the reservation list updates instantly to remove or update that entry.
The seat map reflects updated seat statuses immediately after any reservation action.
No stale data is shown after accept/deny actions.

requirements.text: Optimize the ticket acceptance flow in the ReservationManager to reduce perceived latency. Apply optimistic UI updates so the reservation status changes immediately on click, with a rollback if the backend call fails. Show a loading indicator on the action button that was clicked to prevent duplicate submissions.

quotes: Make the acceptance of ticket quick

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking 'Confirm' or 'Cancel' on a reservation immediately updates the UI optimistically before the backend responds.
If the backend call fails, the UI rolls back to the previous state and shows an error toast.
The action buttons show a loading/spinner state while the mutation is in-flight.
Users cannot click the same action button multiple times while it is loading.

requirements.text: After an admin blocks a user, trigger a backend-side cleanup that also invalidates and refetches the reservation list and seat plan on the frontend, so the admin immediately sees blocked users' bookings disappear from the UI.

quotes: fix the problem of not removing booking of people I have block
fix the changes after the acceptance or denial of the ticket

acceptanceCriteria: After blocking a user, the ReservationManager no longer shows that user's reservations.
Seats previously held by the blocked user revert to available status on the seat map.
The frontend React Query cache is invalidated for reservations and seat plans after a block action.

constraints: All Motoko logic must remain in the single backend/main.mo actor file.
Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui.
Preserve the existing dark cinematic theme and layout of the admin panel.
nonGoals: Redesigning the admin panel layout or visual theme.
Adding new user roles beyond the existing admin/user system.
Changes to the food menu or bill receipt flow.
